description: This source file implements functionality for managing a whitelist of origin-domain pairs, parsing JSON data, requesting whitelist data from WPEFramework, and adding entries to WebKit's whitelist. It defines classes, functions, and interactions with WebKit internals.

classes.name: JSONEntry
classes.description: A class representing a JSON entry with origin, domain, and subdomain flag used in parsing whitelist JSON data.

classes.name: WhiteListedOriginDomainsList
classes.description: A class that manages a whitelist of origin-domain pairs, parsing JSON data, requesting data from WPEFramework, and applying the whitelist to WebKit.

methods.name: ParseWhiteList
methods.description: Parses a JSON string containing whitelist entries and populates the internal whitelist map.

methods.name: WhiteListedOriginDomainsList::RequestFromWPEFramework
methods.description: Requests the whitelist data from WPEFramework via a synchronous message and returns a populated whitelist object.

methods.name: WhiteListedOriginDomainsList::AddWhiteListToWebKit
methods.description: Adds the stored whitelist entries to the WebKit environment.
